protocol_deviations: No complete FDA orphan approval export was reconciled. Ledger is a screened candidate set, not an exhaustive universe or denominator for selection adjustment.
No historical record satisfies the complete 36/60-month, risk-treatment, geography and vintage requirements. Strict quantitative sample remains empty; contextual point comparisons are separate.

Current CAMP reports arrived during work and were added as a separate benchmark; they did not change historical cohort rules.
Machine-readable JSON replaces the preferred CSV because nested source, scope and exclusion fields are retained without flattening. Calculations are reproducible with standard Python.

data_dictionary.sales_usdm: USD millions of recognized net product sales, unless record explicitly states otherwise; no inflation/FX conversion.
data_dictionary.original_sales_usdm: Published forecast value before any transformation; operator preserves > bounds.
data_dictionary.conditional_sales_usdm: Approval-conditional sales only when risk handling is documented. Null for unresolved historical records, never zero.
data_dictionary.pos: Disclosed scalar approval probability; null means unknown. Not inferred from discount rate or price target.
data_dictionary.target_year: Forecast calendar year; null denotes undated peak. It is not commercial-year index.
data_dictionary.report_date: Original note/publication date when recovered; null when only publication of a quotation is known.
data_dictionary.geography: Exact stated or unresolved territory; unknown must not be silently treated as worldwide.
data_dictionary.strict_eligible: Requires genuine preapproval vintage, identifiable revenue scope, recoverable conditional forecast and matched complete horizon.
data_dictionary.status: Observed = source transcription; derived = arithmetic; proxy = imperfect measure; assumed = hypothesis; unknown = unresolved.
data_dictionary.source: Key into sources; local originals use absolute path, web evidence uses direct URL.
data_dictionary.verification: Degree of clinical/regulatory screening, separate from forecast data quality.
data_dictionary.decision: Scientific cohort screening decision; quantitative data exclusion remains separate.
data_dictionary.candidate_year: US year where checked; review/index-seeded entries remain subject to individual approval adjudication.
data_dictionary.prior_deck_audit: Compiler-reported estimates and issues are separate from authenticated original broker records. Do not silently merge peak revisions into historical forecast-error results.
